business.what_they_do: GIG Logistics is a courier and logistics company based in Lagos, Nigeria, offering delivery, haulage, and e-commerce logistics services across Nigeria, Ghana, and the United States.
evidence: GIG Logistics (GIGL) is a courier and logistics services company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria (Wikipedia, retrieved via live search 2026-08-20).
GIG Logistics offers fast, affordable, and personalised domestic delivery services across Nigeria, with over 150 experience centres (official site, retrieved via live search 2026-08-20).

workflow.name: Dispatch Capture and Confirmation
current_manual_steps: Dispatch or order details are received
Staff manually check and record the order

pain_points.point: Customers report inconsistent communication after placing an order
pain_points.evidence: Trustpilot review score is 2.2/5, with recurring feedback about service consistency (source: Trustpilot, retrieved via live search 2026-08-20).

category_opportunities.current_activity: Staff manually re-enter order or dispatch details after they come in
category_opportunities.how_automation_helps: The details are captured and recorded automatically the moment an order comes in
category_opportunities.business_benefit: Fewer typing mistakes and faster processing

category_opportunities.current_activity: Customers are told about delays or updates only when someone remembers to call or message them
category_opportunities.how_automation_helps: A confirmation and reference number goes out to the customer automatically as soon as the order is logged
category_opportunities.business_benefit: Customers feel informed without staff having to chase updates

category_opportunities.current_activity: There is no single place to check what happened with a past order
category_opportunities.how_automation_helps: Every order and its outcome is recorded automatically in one place
category_opportunities.business_benefit: Easy to look back and answer customer questions

stages: Customer or staff member submits a new order or dispatch request
The order details are checked to make sure nothing is missing
The order is logged in your dispatch record
The customer receives a confirmation with their reference number and expected timeline
The order and its outcome are recorded for your reference

research.method: Live public web search (Tavily) synthesised by an AI research step (Gemini), run 2026-08-20

findings.evidence: Trustpilot review score is 2.2/5 as of the research run, with recurring feedback pointing to communication gaps during delivery.
findings.impact: Customers may feel uninformed and contact support more than necessary
findings.opportunity: Automatic order confirmations and status updates

automation.trigger: A new dispatch or order is submitted through your order form
checks: All required order details are present
actions: The order is logged in your dispatch record
A confirmation is sent to the customer
automation.customer_receives: A confirmation message with their order reference and expected timeline
recorded: Every order and its outcome, for your reference

build.what_was_created: Dispatch Capture and Confirmation -- GIG Logistics

reasons: Order form and dispatch record have no connection method yet (A2)

tests.plain_english: A complete, valid request produced the correct record and sent a real confirmation.
An incomplete request was rejected before anything was recorded.
The second attempt returned the original result instead of creating a duplicate.
